description:
Application that checks the SKU of a Pixel device to Region Lock the Felica chip (Japanese NFC technology used in E-money cards) of the phone to prevent non-Japanese people from using it.
Removing it will make the Osaifu-Keitai crash upon start-up but will not cause any bootloop.
Patching it (ROOT), however allows people with a Felica Chip to add IC cards to their phone and use it to pay while in Japan.
